claims: Sundance Institute was founded by Robert Redford in 1981.
Sundance Institute is a Park City-based nonprofit.
Sundance Institute is dedicated to discovering and supporting independent filmmakers, theater artists, and composers worldwide.
Sundance Institute provides year-round artistic development through labs, grants, and mentorships.
Sundance Institute's year-round artistic development culminates in the annual Sundance Film Festival.
Sundance Institute operates labs and mentorship programs including Feature Film, Documentary Film Program, and Theatre programs.
Sundance Film Festival is an annual showcase for independent storytelling in Park City, Utah.
Sundance Ignite supports artists aged 18 to 25 with labs, screenings, and creative mentorship.
Adobe Producers Program provides year-round support to producers through labs, workshops, and grants.
Sundance Institute offers the Documentary Fund.
Sundance Collab is an online community and learning platform.
Sundance Institute's headquarters is in Park City, Utah.
